title: Commutators of finite multiplicative order
summary: This article studies the equation $[A,B]^k = \Id_n$ for matrices over $\CC$,characterizing the pairs $(k,n)$ for which solutions exist via a classical result of Lam and Leung on sums of roots of unity. The problem is next generalized to matrix rings $M_n(S)$ over arbitrary unital rings $S$, where a sufficient condition on the unity of $S$ is established and explicit constructions of solutions are provided.
